title: Numerical analysis of the MASnI3/CZT(Se1−xSx) interface to boost the performance via band offset engineering
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16939-16946
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02248G, Paper

Rasmiah S. Almufarij, Muazma Jamil, M. Yasir Ali, M. D. Alshahrani, Salhah Hamed Alrefaee, Mohamed Abdelsabour Fahmy, Islam Ragab, A. R. Abd-Elwahed, Adnan Ali, Arslan Ashfaq
Tin-based perovskite solar cells with a CuZnSn(Se1−xSx) HTL are optimized via SCAPS simulation. Tunable VBO enables 18.29% efficiency, with CZTSe0.4S0.6 showing ideal band alignment for enhanced photovoltaic performance.
